title: PersonSummary
description: What the control plane holds for one person, by their HR id, for console administrators (D70): their HR events and the agents labelled with their HR id. Nothing from an HR event's payload is part of this schema.

receipts.description: The person's HR events, the most recently received first, at most 100.

receiptsTruncated.description: The person has more HR events than are listed.

agents.description: The agents labelled with this person's HR id, by name.
